sections.title: 1. Your agreement
sections.body: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of Lumen Studio, a video and photo editor. By checking the agreement box, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not continue using the app. You must be able to agree under applicable law; where required, use the app with a parent or legal guardian's permission and supervision.

sections.title: 2. Editing on your device
sections.body: Lumen Studio lets you import selected media, edit clips, add text, stickers, effects and sounds, save local drafts and export files. Features and supported formats depend on your device and the installed app version. This edition does not provide an account, cloud project storage or automatic transfer between devices.

sections.title: 3. Your content and permissions
sections.body: You keep ownership of content you create or import. You give the app permission to process the media you select on your device only as needed to provide editing, preview, drafts and export. These terms do not transfer ownership of your content to the developer or permit its use for advertising or AI training. Only import or share content you own or have permission to use, including music, images, recordings and people's likenesses. App availability of a tool or asset does not give you rights to third-party content.

sections.title: 4. Responsible use
sections.body: Use the app lawfully and respect intellectual property, privacy and other people's rights. Do not use it to create or distribute child sexual abuse material, unlawful sexual content, threats, fraud, or content that otherwise violates applicable law. Do not misrepresent edited media to deceive or harm others. You are responsible for the content you choose to export or share.

sections.title: 5. Privacy and optional choices
sections.body: Read the separate Privacy policy in Settings. Photos, videos and projects remain on your device. This connected edition offers optional usage analytics, remote ad configuration and text-only support through a developer-operated API. Share usage analytics is off by default and is independent of Terms acceptance and Android permissions. Contact Us sends only the support information disclosed before you press Send. You may decline analytics and still edit. This edition does not serve ads; a future ad-enabled edition must meet its own disclosure and consent requirements.

sections.title: 6. Drafts, deletion and exports
sections.body: Keep copies of important source files and exports. Drafts rely on access to their media and are stored on this device. Deleting or moving source media, revoking access, clearing Android app storage or uninstalling may make drafts unavailable or delete private editing data. Delete drafts in Projects and imported sounds in the sound library. Clearing storage in Android Settings removes app-private editing data; originals and exports outside app storage remain under your control. Check your exported file before deleting originals or relying on it.

sections.title: 7. Quality and availability
sections.body: Preview and export results depend on source quality, format, device resources and editing choices. A higher output resolution cannot restore missing source detail. Some formats or export settings may be unsupported. We do not promise uninterrupted operation or recovery of lost work. We aim to correct reported problems, and features may change as the app is updated.

sections.title: 8. App and third-party services
sections.body: You may use Lumen Studio for personal or lawful commercial editing, subject to separate content and asset rights. The software and branding remain protected by applicable rights. Open-source components retain their own licences. File providers, sharing services and the hosting/database provider used for support operate under their own applicable terms and privacy practices. Support messages are sent to the administrator only after you press Send; they are not uploaded as part of media editing.

sections.title: 9. Consumer rights and responsibility
sections.body: Nothing in these terms excludes or limits rights, remedies, warranties or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, including mandatory consumer protections. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the developer is not responsible for loss caused by misuse, unavailable source files, third-party services or events beyond reasonable control. These terms do not require you to waive statutory rights.

sections.title: 10. Changes and contact
sections.body: The effective date identifies this version of the terms. Material changes will be presented for renewed agreement in the app. You may stop using the app at any time. For questions or support, use Contact Us in Settings or the support address shown above. In test editions with example details, sending is unavailable until the developer configures a real contact address. The separate Privacy policy and Play Store disclosures must reflect any future changes to data handling before they are released.
